XData.name: Menu
XData.Data:
<MenuBase> <Menu Name="%SourceMenu" Type="0"> <MenuItem Name="%CheckOut"/> <MenuItem Name="%UndoCheckout"/> <MenuItem Name="%CheckIn" Save="100"/> <MenuItem Name="%GetLatest"/> <MenuItem Name="%AddToSourceControl" Save="100"/> </Menu> <Menu Name="%SourceContext" Type="1"> <MenuItem Name="%CheckOut"/> <MenuItem Name="%UndoCheckout"/> <MenuItem Name="%CheckIn" Save="100"/> <MenuItem Name="%GetLatest"/> <MenuItem Name="%AddToSourceControl" Save="100"/> </Menu>
</MenuBase>

Method.name: UserAction
AfterUserAction
Method.Implementation: Write !, "AfterUserAction" Set Reload=0 #; Note if you implement this method yourself you can remove all the code below, this is just included #; for backward compatibility with previous versions of the source control hooks. If Type=0 { Set menu=$piece(Name,",") If menu'="%SourceMenu",menu'="%SourceContext" Quit $$$OK Set name=$piece(Name,",",2) Set action=$case(name,"%CheckIn":-1,"%CheckOut":0,"%AddToSourceControl":1,"%GetLatest":3,"%UndoCheckout":10,:-2) If action=-2 Quit $$$ERROR($$$StudioSourceActionInvalid,Name,InternalName) } ElseIf Type=1 { Set action=Name } write !, "AfterUserAction In action logic: " _ Answer _ " " _ action If Answer'=1 Quit $$$OK If action=-1 Quit ..CheckIn(InternalName,Msg) If action=0 Quit ..CheckOut(InternalName,Msg) If action=1 Quit ..AddToSourceControl(InternalName,Msg) If action=2 Quit ..RemoveFromSourceControl(InternalName,Msg) If action=3 Quit ..GetLatest(InternalName) If action=10 Set Reload=1 Quit ..UndoCheckout(InternalName) Quit $$$OK

Method.name: OnMenuItem
CheckIn
Method.Description: Check this routine/class/csp file into source control.
Method.Implementation:
set username = "lpjnaras" Set file = "" Set file=..ExternalName(InternalName) Set namespace=$zu(5),timeout=2
write !, "In Check in - added by " _ username _ " file: " _ file _ " in Name space: " _ namespace write !, "Check status: " _ InternalName
DO ..GetLatest(InternalName) SET baseDir = "C:\EnsembleSC\" SET fullFile = baseDir _ file
if ( ##class(%File).Exists(fullFile) ) { Set stat = ..CommitToSvn(file)
if stat = 0 { Set IsCheckedOut=0 } } Quit $$$OK

Method.name: CheckOut
UndoCheckout
AddToSourceControl
Method.Description: Called to add this item to source control
Method.Implementation:
write !, "Add to Src Ctrl: " _ InternalName Set file = "" Set file=..ExternalName(InternalName) Set namespace=$zu(5),timeout=2 SET baseDir = "C:\EnsembleSC\" SET fullFile = baseDir _ file write !, "By " _ $username ,!, " file: " _ file _ " in Name space: " _ namespace
Set sc = $System.OBJ.Export(InternalName, fullFile)
write !, " Add to SourceControl: " _ fullFile _ " export: " _ sc
SET status = ..AddToSvn(file)
if status = 0 { write !, "File is in SourceControl" Set IsInSourceControl=1 }
Quit $$$OK

Method.name: AddToSvn
CommitToSvn
Method.Implementation:
set username = "lpjnaras" set stat = $$$ERROR(9100, "Cound not add") SET fullPath = "C:\EnsembleSC" SET fileParts = $Length(fName, "/") Write !, fileParts FOR ind=1:1:fileParts { set dirName = $PIECE(fName, "/", ind) set fullPath = fullPath _ "\" _ dirName Set cmd = "svn cleanup " _ fullPath ; a non-recursive commit (-N) Set stat = $ZF(-1, cmd) Set cmd = "svn --username " _ username _ " commit -N -m ""Testing"" " _ fullPath ; a non-recursive commit (-N) Set stat = $ZF(-1, cmd) Write !, cmd _ " - SVN STAT: " _ stat }
Quit stat

Method.name: ExternalName
Name
Method.Description: Return the name of this item without the prefix to be added by ExtName

Method.name: setSources
GetLatest
Method.Description: Get the latest version of this file from Ensemble to checkin to source control.
Method.Implementation:
write !, "Get Latest " _ $username _ " file: " _ InternalName write !, "Add to Src Ctrl: " _ InternalName Set file = "" Set file=..ExternalName(InternalName) Set namespace=$zu(5),timeout=2 SET baseDir = "C:\EnsembleSC\" SET fullFile = baseDir _ file write !, "By " _ $username ,!, " file: " _ file _ " in Name space: " _ namespace
Set sc = $System.OBJ.Export(InternalName, fullFile)
write !, " New file updated to SourceControl: " _ fullFile _ " export: " _ sc
Quit $$$OK

Method.name: GetStatus
ReadSvnFile
Method.Implementation:
Set InFile="c:\Temp\svnStat.txt" Close InFile Open InFile:"R":10 If '$Test Write !,InFile," cannot be opened." Quit 0 do ##class(%SYSTEM.Process).SetZEOF(1)
Use InFile ;sets InFile as the current device Read InRecord ;read record from file
If $ZEOF '= -1 { Use 0 Write 1, "Data" Set IsInSourceControl=1 Set stat = $E(InRecord, 1,1) if (stat = "A") || (stat = "M") { Set IsCheckedOut=1 Set UserCheckedOut= $username } elseif (stat = "?") { Set IsCheckedOut=0 Set IsInSourceControl = 0 } } else { Set IsInSourceControl = 1 } Close InFile Do ##class(%File).Delete(InFile) Quit 0
